purpose: Evaluate the explicitly selected nominal KF96 number-rate prescription on the 17 saved P01 warm OFF states. This is postprocessing of an immutable baseline, not an RCT-enabled solver/history or a materiality decision.

searched: REI research JSON/Markdown/Python filenames and targeted rate-only text
deduplication.finding: No existing warm-P01 17-epoch RCT rate-only screen was found. STEP01 synthetic stepper tests and older RCT03 conditional histories are different inputs and are not rerun. No claim of exhaustive global absence.

historical_manifest_relation: physical_provider_20261010/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json pins background.py and CONTRACT.json to the hashes above and the historical extended_dataset.npz to 3cbf35cf7910c37083de4c5b9db443c71b272f3877a48f74fb9f852fd70fe2be. The present production dataset is a distinct committed P01 output; do not mislabel it as a manifest-listed historical research input.

provider_files.role: Imported shared validation/error definitions only. Its GM25 rate must not be selected or evaluated for the warm baseline.

selected_provider.semantics: Nominal compilation prescription with an explicit W82 ground-state mapping. Factor-17 source disagreement is acknowledged, not treated as uncertainty.

saved_data_mapping.time: Proper elapsed gas seconds, t_i=i*6250000000 for i=0..16. Volume-redshift labels must not be used as a time coordinate.
saved_data_mapping.density: JSON nH_cm3 is proper density. nH_m3=1e6*nH_cm3. Frozen Y=0.24 and mHe=4*mproton give nHe/nH=Y/[4(1-Y)]=3/38; compute nHe_m3=(3/38)*nH_m3 without a new background solve.
saved_data_mapping.frame: Local comoving gas rest frame under the existing zero-tilt warm test-field background. Number rates are scalar collision rates and require no photon direction Jacobian.
saved_data_mapping.background_execution: Do not import/run background.py or the production interval runner. Their pinned source establishes the saved-data convention only.

quantities.primary_count_rate: R, under the explicit one-primary-photon ground-channel scenario; no tracked radiation source or photon energy is computed.

optional_trapezoid.relative_volume: a_rel_cubed=nH_m3(t0)/nH_m3(t), by the frozen model's conserved hydrogen nuclei
optional_trapezoid.comoving_event_count: Trapezoid of a_rel_cubed*R over saved proper times, in events per initial proper cubic metre. This equals the integral of the piecewise-linear interpolant of these saved integrand samples.
optional_trapezoid.fraction_exposures: Trapezoids of R/nH and +/-R/nHe over the same times, dimensionless frozen-baseline source exposures. These are not evolved fraction differences.
optional_trapezoid.label: SAVED_GRID_PIECEWISE_LINEAR_RATE_EXPOSURE_DIAGNOSTIC
optional_trapezoid.prohibited_interpretation: Not a certified integral of the continuous baseline, not an RCT-ON coupled state, and not an upper bound or N5 materiality certificate. Do not infer a continuum error from this one grid.

input_checks: Verify all pinned input/provider file hashes before import/readout
P01 metadata execution_path is production SourceBoundConditional and optional_CR_RCT_HH is OFF
Exactly 17 finite strictly increasing proper times with the frozen endpoints/grid
NPZ ionic values and times equal their JSON roundtrip values; this is input-field binding, not equality of independent numerical outputs
All fractions in [0,1], xHeII+xHeIII<=1, nH>0, finite positive T
T inside both historical 30000..110000 K guard and selected KF96 domain
Provider returns the frozen source_id, reaction_id, unit and positive nominal rate token
acceptance.arithmetic_reference: Independently form each rate, species rate, fraction rate and optional trapezoid in Decimal precision70 using Decimal.from_float for stored binary64 fields and exact decimal1e-20, integer1e6 and rational3/38. The reference must not reuse candidate computed densities/rates.
acceptance.comparison_rule: For a nonzero Decimal reference require abs(candidate-reference)<=5e-13*abs(reference). Exact structural-zero outputs must be zero. This bounds implementation arithmetic relative to the recorded inputs, not the physical prescription or grid interpolation error.
acceptance.conservation: H and He nuclei changes and free-electron/charge source cancel under the declared stoichiometry; fraction-density reconstructed species rates agree with the same 5e-13 relative criterion scaled by R.
acceptance.cross_unit_check: For every epoch call the same KF96 provider in cm3 s-1 too; convert k_cgs*nHI_cm3*nHeIII_cm3 to m^-3 s^-1 with factor1e6 and compare to SI path at5e-13 relative. No extra density or volume factor.
acceptance.density_crosscheck: Reconstruct ne_cm3=nH_cm3*xHII+(3/38)*nH_cm3*(xHeII+2*xHeIII) and compare with the saved ne_cm3 at5e-13 relative.
acceptance.nonzero_product: Reject nonfinite or zero rate when k,nHI,nHeIII are all positive; preserve exact zero for a zero reactant. Do not clip fractions, densities, T or rates.
bounded_controls: intentional input-hash mismatch rejects before computation
acceptance.failure_rule: Preserve the first failing input/check/stdout/stderr. Stop; no scientific policy, tolerance or source change and no automatic rerun. Return for one named repair classification under remaining cumulative limits.

lower_tier_execution.paths: Create one unique task-owned /tmp/RCT_RATE_ONLY27.* directory with apply_patch-authored script and factual outputs. Existing repositories and archived/source files remain read-only. No new Git worktree/clone/init is needed.
outputs: per_epoch.csv or JSON with exact field units and 17 rows
VALIDATION.json containing arithmetic maxima, controls, source hashes, declared scope and null missing moments
COMMAND_EXIT_STDOUT_STDERR receipt with actual Python/NumPy versions and measured process time
factual short Korean result and next gate
